limitations: This is exact source/metadata/CPU approval for future execution preparation, not human permission or a native qualification. No PilotV2 model load, generation, backward, optimizer update or accuracy measurement occurred.

The new native two-macro path has not run on MLX. Existing V1 actual restore/F32 evidence is inherited narrowly; CPU fake success cannot establish future native memory, gradient, checkpoint or accuracy success.

The TRAIN8 prompt diagnostic chooses between exactly one fixed concise condition and original according to its predeclared rule. Any resulting prompt gain must remain separate from RL gain; all A/B/Parent accuracy comparisons use the selected common condition.

V2 batches two complete patient rounds per update. Relative to V1, the batch doubles and per-response joint weight halves from1/16to1/32; V1-to-V2 changes cannot be attributed exclusively to Paired-Prompt grouping. Within V2 A/B only sequence grouping differs.

The first32 sampled responses are shared only at the original common parent. Segment1 must use each arms own current policy and persisted RNG; if weights diverge those later rollouts are different draws, with the same fixed sampling rule and data/call budget.
All four TRAIN patients are processed through two complete macros even if some groups are inactive. Actual updates remain0/1/2per arm; extra active groups or gradient norms are not accuracy gains.

Existing paired evaluations support equivalent fixed-input conditional-response analysis, not a new randomized independent image-swap intervention or anatomical/clinical grounding. INVALID changes must not count as valid visual discrimination.

DEV24 is four previously explored patients. Dallas is an ENGINEERING_ONLY training control and no Dallas retention evaluation is included. Candidate scores/null images/new16/final100 are not part of this scope; no generalization claim follows.

Up to2cooperative recoveries are allowed only within9total load attempts and original cumulative stage/global windows; waits never reset deadlines. Incomplete scientific operations are INDETERMINATE_NO_REPLAY, not losslessly replayable.

GREEN/YELLOW/RED safeguards retain RSS14GiB, MLX12GiB, disk26GiB, battery20percent and severe-memory/OOM checks, but sampled monitors have atomic-operation blind spots. Thermal telemetry may remain unavailable and no system-stability/OOM guarantee is possible.

Performance/cost-model windows are bounded estimates from V1, not guaranteed runtime or evidence of compute-efficiency improvement. Scope counts API endpoints rather than every internal kernel/checkpoint recomputation.

Claude Code implemented the new code at its actual commits; this isolated Codex review is independent source/CPU review. No new cross-family native-results review is claimed because PilotV2 remains NOT_RUN.
privacy_review: Only aggregate exposure, scalar budgets, hashes, source commit references and source-review findings; no patient identities, raw answers/tokens, MRI payloads, weights, optimizer/RNG arrays or credentials.

prompt.decision_rule: ADOPT_CONCISE iff, on the SAME 8 frozen TRAIN images and Parent Adam52 greedy: concise invalid <= original invalid, no class loses a correct answer, and (concise invalid < original invalid OR concise correct > original correct). Otherwise KEEP_ORIGINAL. Frozen before any call; DEV24 is never used for this decision.

resolved_material_findings.issue: Mutable arm ledger was captured by an immutable segment0 journal manifest and invalidated by segment1 spending.

resolved_material_findings.resolution: _completed authenticates exact scope/terminal/exit/reaped lock/closed logs. Skip reasons are re-derived and must have no native artifacts. _prior authenticates all earlier stages and the root loop uses _completed.
